svg.title: Agentroid: the most phone control for the fewest tokens
svg.desc: Agentroid banner. One real Android screen as the raw uiautomator dump, 30,910 characters; the full ui_tree listing, 2,550; the default digest, 453; and a since= diff with nothing changed, 65. Below: 27 tools in under 5,000 tokens, a 400-character default digest, refs kept 100% over 200 re-layouts, 0 model calls in the server.
